case_title: JAIME SOFFER VS. PHILIP BOWERS et al

docket_entries.description: PERSONAL INJURY/PROPERTY DAMAGE - VEHICLE RELATED, COMPLAINT FILED BY PLAINTIFF SOFFER, JAIME AS TO DEFENDANT BOWERS, PHILIP DOES 1 TO 25 SUMMONS ISSUED, JUDICIAL COUNCIL CIVIL CASE COVER SHEET FILED CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE SCHEDULED FOR MAR-20-2013 PROOF OF SERVICE DUE ON                  DEC-17-2012 CASE MANAGEMENT STATEMENT DUE ON         MAR-05-2013
CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE OF MAR-20-2013 CONTINUED TO MAY-01-2013 AT 10:30 AM IN DEPARTMENT 610. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE SET FOR JUN-11-2013 IN DEPARTMENT 610 AT 10:30 AM FOR FAILURE TO FILE PROOF OF SERVICE ON DEFENDANT(S) AND OBTAIN ANSWER(S), OR ENTER DEFAULT(S). THE MAY-01-2013 CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE IS OFF CALENDAR. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.
MINI MINUTES FOR JUN-11-2013 10:30 AM FOR DEPT 610

SANCTIONS ORDERED IN THE AMOUNT OF $400.00 AGAINST MICHAEL T CALDWELL, ESQ. FOR FAILURE TO APPEAR AT THE ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE HEARING ON: JUN-11-2013, PAYABLE ON OR BEFORE JUN-28-2013. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE SET FOR JUN-11-2013 CONTINUED TO AUG-13-2013 AT 10:30 AM IN DEPARTMENT 610 FOR FAILURE TO FILE PROOF OF SERVICE ON DEFENDANT(S) AND OBTAIN ANSWER(S), OR ENTER DEFAULT(S). NOTICE SENT BY COURT.
DECLARATION RE: OSC FAILURE TO APPEAR AND ORDER TO PAY SANCTIONS FILED BY PLAINTIFF SOFFER, JAIME
DISMISSAL OF ENTIRE ACTION OF ALL PARTIES AND ALL CAUSES OF ACTION WITHOUT PREJUDICE
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE OF AUG-13-2013 IS OFF CALENDAR. DISMISSAL ON FILE. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.
